security_audit.summary: All static findings were false positives caused by Markdown code fences, documented Firebase setup commands, placeholder configuration values, official documentation links, and Firestore rule syntax. remediation.suggestion: Label CLI commands as developer-run setup steps and prefer project-local installs when possible.

content.user_title: Integrate Firebase AI Logic in Apps
content.value_statement: Firebase teams often need safe patterns for adding Gemini features without scattered setup notes. This skill guides Firebase AI Logic setup, SDK usage, prompt handling, and basic security practices.
actual_capabilities: Guides Firebase project setup and AI Logic console enablement.
Shows Firebase SDK installation and web initialization patterns.
Provides examples for text generation, streaming, and image prompts.
Includes Firestore rules for protecting AI request logs.
Outlines project structure for AI clients, prompts, and handlers.
Lists operational practices for errors, rate limits, caching, and keys.
limitations: It does not provide a complete production application.
Examples require your own Firebase project and configuration values.
It does not replace Firebase console setup or billing controls.
The image helper is illustrative and needs implementation.

use_cases.title: Add Gemini Text Features
use_cases.description: Build summarization, translation, or content generation into an existing Firebase web app.

use_cases.title: Prototype Multimodal AI
use_cases.description: Create a Firebase-backed image analysis flow using Gemini prompts and image input.

use_cases.title: Review AI App Structure
use_cases.description: Plan project files, request logging, and basic rules before adding AI features.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up Firebase AI Logic
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a Firebase web project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to outline the steps for enabling Firebase AI Logic in my web app. Include SDK setup and required Firebase console actions.

prompt_templates.title: Add Text Generation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design a Firebase AI Logic text generation feature. Include prompt handling, error handling, and where files should live.

prompt_templates.title: Implement Streaming Responses
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to add streaming Gemini responses to my Firebase app. Include UI flow, handler responsibilities, and logging considerations.

prompt_templates.title: Audit AI Feature Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review my Firebase AI Logic plan for security, rate limits, sensitive data handling, caching, and deployment readiness.

output_examples.input: I need Gemini text generation in a Firebase web app.
output_examples.output: A setup plan covering console enablement, SDK installation, Firebase initialization, a generation handler, and validation steps.

output_examples.input: I want image analysis with Firebase AI Logic.
output_examples.output: A multimodal feature outline describing image preparation, prompt design, model calls, error handling, and safe storage decisions.

output_examples.input: Check my AI request logging approach.
output_examples.output: A review of log ownership, Firestore rule intent, sensitive data limits, and practical rate-control recommendations.

best_practices: Keep Firebase configuration values out of committed source files.
Validate user prompts and avoid sending sensitive data to AI services.
Add rate limits, caching, and clear fallback behavior before launch.
anti_patterns: Do not hardcode real API keys in client examples or repositories.
Do not allow unlimited AI requests from unauthenticated users.
Do not log prompts or responses that contain private user data.

faq.question: What does this skill help me build?
faq.answer: It helps you add Firebase AI Logic features such as text generation, streaming responses, and image analysis.

faq.question: Does it configure Firebase automatically?
faq.answer: No. It explains the setup steps, but you still perform console configuration and project-specific changes.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it include security guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers input validation, API key handling, rate limits, and Firestore rules for AI logs.

faq.question: Does it provide production-ready code?
faq.answer: No. It provides implementation patterns that need review, testing, and adaptation for your app.

faq.question: What Firebase features are covered?
faq.answer: It covers Firebase AI Logic setup, Firebase SDK initialization, Gemini model calls, streaming, and Firestore rules.
